changedFiles.change: Extended existing componentReceiptProbe for AT-ops-45 using the existing research.component-receipts CLI owner and ModelRoute delegationFixture. No public interface, DTO, contract, producer, module, or generated file changed.

publicPath: toy probe run AT-ops-45 --json -> registered research.component-receipts -> ModelRouteProbe.run -> componentReceiptProbe -> ModelRoute.delegationReceipt and EngineeringControl.checkResearch
implementedAssertions: Reads the current A14 component, required decision, report source keys, and original archive digest through EngineeringControl.checkResearch; submits the canonical ResearchComponentComparisonV3 overlay through the same public API and verifies archive path/original digest/content digest plus the report comparison digest.

Uses the nine-case existing route/skill matrix against the A14 objective. The successful research receipt must match the SHA-256 of current trusted behavior/models.yaml bytes, request and observe gpt-6.1-sol/medium/priority, match every pinned research-skill field/resource, use the codex_exec fast arguments, and retain nativeExecutionVerified=false and acceptanceComplete=false.

The ordinary A14 implementation case uses a distinct checklist objective and must match the same policy digest, request and observe gpt-6-luna/max/priority, use fast executor arguments, and have no research skill.

Route-fault cases must refuse and match only ROUTE:R0:A14 in the route/skill validation projection; skill-fault and ordinary-child cases must match ROUTE:R0:A14 plus SKILL:R0:A14. The probe records unrelated validation gaps, keeps whole register admission BLOCKED and wholeATComplete=false, and does not equate the subgate with AT completion.

The module-local override case now converts only INVALID_INPUT with zero external sends into a passing CheckView instead of returning early. Other errors remain failures. No provider result or A14 research acceptance is fabricated for this case.

AT-ops-45 CheckView prerequisites are compacted and guarded at 2,000 characters; they carry policy/receipt digests, route and skill evidence, archive and overlay digests, subgate state, error/send status, and fixture-only limitations without serializing the full receipt or raw output.
